BillHeading.Sponsors: Senate Local Government (originally sponsored by Senators Warnick, Wagoner, Chapman, Dozier, and Wellman)

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to promoting agritourism in Washington; and adding a new section to chapter 19.27 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 19.27 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Agricultural buildings used for agritourism activities, as defined in RCW 4.24.830, are not subject to building code standards that apply to a commercial building permit, except standards to meet all life and fire safety requirements, if the building is only used for agritourism activities six months or less every year.
